items.label: Powerful Steam Cleaner
items.value: This steam cleaner heats up in just 15 seconds, releasing high-temperature steam at 221°F (105°C) and 3 bar of pressure, instantly dissolving stubborn grease, grime, stains, and bacteria. With a power output of 1500 watts, it effortlessly removes dirt and is a reliable helper for everyday household cleaning

items.label: 6-Level Adjustable Touch Control
items.value: Simply press the “+” or “-” buttons on the handheld steam cleaner to easily switch between six steam intensity settings to suit your cleaning needs. Whether you’re cleaning tire treads or the upholstery and trim inside your car, this car detailing steam cleaner ensures that all surfaces look brand new. It’s smart, efficient, and easy to use

items.label: Portable Handheld Steam Cleaner Design
items.value: The ergonomic handle and intuitive water tank design make filling and draining a breeze. The large 1.25-liter water tank supports extended cleaning sessions, allowing you to clean multiple areas efficiently and without interruption. Equipped with a 6.6-foot steam hose and a 4.92-foot power cord, this steam cleaner allows for easy maneuverability throughout the room

items.label: 16 Multi-Purpose Accessories
items.value: Equipped with a brush head, scraper, nozzle, cleaning cloth, gloves, and other tools designed for a wide range of cleaning tasks.It is suitable for use on floors, sofas, windows, kitchen appliances, and bathrooms, as well as outdoor areas such as pet-friendly zones and cars, making it easy to achieve a thorough, deep clean in any setting

items.label: Family-Friendly
items.value: Our steam cleaner uses only pure steam to powerfully remove dirt and grease—with no chemical additives, no toxic fumes, and no residue. We help create a healthy, safe living environment so you can breathe easy while cleaning

items.label: Widely Used
items.value: The handheld steam cleaner is a true all-purpose cleaning expert and the perfect choice for homes, offices, and car interiors. Whether it’s tile grout, bathroom corners, car interiors, or furniture surfaces, it delivers deep cleaning power with high-temperature steam. With just one machine, you can easily tackle a variety of surfaces, including hard floors, carpets, and fabric upholstery.
